blog.title: Blog
blog.intro: Blog articles stored in the database. What you publish here goes live on the site right away.

editor.slugHelp: Goes in the URL. Lowercase, numbers and hyphens. It cannot change once published.
editor.dateHelp: Madrid time. Empty means now. A future date schedules it.
editor.ogHelp: A path like /blog-img/slug/og.jpg, 1200x630. If empty, one will be generated.

editor.ogRemove: Remove this image and use the generated one (save to apply it)
editor.ogGeneratedAlt: Thumbnail of the social image generated by code

keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: Keys let Claude's routine create drafts in the blog. They never publish, they only write drafts that you review here.

keys.name: Name

keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key {nombre}? Any routine using it will stop working.
keys.errName: The name allows letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens and underscores, up to 60.
keys.errMax: There are already 10 active keys. Revoke one before creating another.
keys.errSave: It could not be completed. Try again.
